title: Đề 16: Dùng điện thoại + phòng ngủ - camping + gặp người nước ngoài

questions.stem: In this part, I am going to ask you three short questions about yourself and your interests. You will have 30 seconds to reply to each question.

questions: 1. Tell me the last time you saw a movie.
2. Tell me about your typical day.

questions.stem: In this part, I'm going to ask you to describe a picture. Then I will ask you two questions about it. You will have 45 seconds for each response.

questions: What do you usually use your mobile phone for?
Do you think smartphones are making people less social in real life?

questions.title: Đề 16: Dùng điện thoại + ngủ trong nhà - camping + gặp người nước ngoài - Part 2

questions.stem: In this part, I'm going to ask you to compare two pictures, and I will then ask you two questions about them. You will have 45 seconds for each response.

questions: Tell me what can you see in two pictures.
Do you think sleep is important?
Is spending the night in places like this attractive?

questions.title: Đề 16: Dùng điện thoại + ngủ trong nhà - camping + gặp người nước ngoài - Part 3

questions.stem: In this part, I'm going to show you a picture and ask you three questions. You will have one minute to think about your answers before you start speaking. You will have two minutes to answer all three questions.

questions: 1. Tell me a time you met or talk with a foreigner.
2. Why do some people feel shy or nervous when communicating with strangers from other countries?
3. Do you think interacting with people from different cultural backgrounds is important
